@gen function mortality(mode::Symbol)
    cancer   = ({:cancer} ~ bernoulli(0.00001))
    cold     = ({:cold} ~ bernoulli(0.2))
    d_cancer = ({:d_cancer} ~ bernoulli(0.9))
    d_cold   = ({:d_cold} ~ bernoulli(0.00006))
    d_other  = ({:d_other} ~ bernoulli(0.000000001))
    death = (cancer && d_cancer) || (cold && d_cold) || d_other
    if mode == :death
        {:obs} ~ bernoulli(death ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    elseif mode == :death_cold
        {:obs} ~ bernoulli((death && cold) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    elseif mode == :death_nocold
        {:obs} ~ bernoulli((death && !cold) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    end
    return cancer
end

@gen function cough(force_lung::Bool, cond_lung::Bool)
    lung = force_lung ? true : ({:lc} ~ bernoulli(0.01))
    if cond_lung; {:cond} ~ bernoulli(lung ? 1.0 : 0.0); end
    cold = ({:cold} ~ bernoulli(0.2))
    cc = ({:cc} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    cl = ({:cl} ~ bernoulli(0.3))

@gen function bob()
    nice = ({:nice} ~ bernoulli(0.7))
    wt = ({:wt} ~ bernoulli(nice ? 0.2 : 0.5))
    for d in 1:5
        w   = ({:w => d}   ~ bernoulli(nice ? 0.2 : 0.5))
        ch1 = ({:ch1 => d} ~ bernoulli(w ? 0.8 : 0.5))
        ch2 = ({:ch2 => d} ~ bernoulli(nice ? 0.8 : 0.5))

    ch2t = ({:ch2t} ~ bernoulli(nice ? 0.8 : 0.5))
    {:smile} ~ bernoulli((ch1t || ch2t) ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    return wt
end

maxNumber = 20
_inrange(s) = unique([v for v in s if 1 <= v <= maxNumber])
_evens() = [v for v in 1:maxNumber if v % 2 == 0]
_odds()  = [v for v in 1:maxNumber if (v+1) % 2 == 0]
_multiples(base) = _inrange([base*v for v in 1:maxNumber])
_powers(base) = _inrange([base^v for v in 0:(maxNumber-1)])   # webppl _.range(maxNumber)=0..19

rule_names = vcat(["multiples_of_$b" for b in 1:11], ["powers_of_$b" for b in 1:11], ["evens","odds"])
function _rule_set(name)
    p = split(name, "_")
    p[1]=="multiples" ? _multiples(parse(Int,p[3])) :
    p[1]=="powers"    ? _powers(parse(Int,p[3])) :
    name=="evens"     ? _evens() : _odds()
end
interval_names = String[]; interval_sets = Vector{Int}[]
for s in 1:maxNumber, e in (s+1):maxNumber
    push!(interval_names, "interval_$(s)_$(e)"); push!(interval_sets, collect(s:e))
end
n_rules = length(rule_names); n_int = length(interval_names)
ALL_NAMES = vcat(rule_names, interval_names)
ALL_SETS  = vcat([_rule_set(n) for n in rule_names], interval_sets)
PRIOR = vcat(fill(0.5/n_rules, n_rules), fill(0.5/n_int, n_int))
EXAMPLES = [3, 10]; TESTQ = 12

@gen function concept()
    h = ({:h} ~ categorical(PRIOR))
    set = ALL_SETS[h]; L = length(set)
    for i in 1:length(EXAMPLES)
        ex = EXAMPLES[i]
        {:obs => i} ~ bernoulli((ex in set) ? (1.0/L) : 0.0)
    end
    return Dict("hypothesis" => ALL_NAMES[h], "testQueryResponse" => (TESTQ in set))
end
obs = choicemap()
for i in 1:length(EXAMPLES); obs[:obs => i] = true; end
grid = choice_vol_grid((:h, collect(1:length(PRIOR))))
ANSWER = __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(concept, (), obs, grid))

@gen function monty(switches)
    alice = ({:a} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    prize = ({:p} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    m     = ({:m} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    {:c1} ~ bernoulli(m != prize ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    {:c2} ~ bernoulli(m != alice ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    final = switches ? (6 - alice - m) : alice
    return final == prize
end

  "switch" => __pplgym_enum_dist(enumerative_inference(monty, (true,),  obs, grid)),
)

@gen function monty_deliberate(switches)
    alice = ({:a} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    prize = ({:p} ~ uniform_discrete(1, 3))
    tie   = ({:tie} ~ bernoulli(0.5))
    remaining = [d for d in 1:3 if d != alice && d != prize]
    m = length(remaining) == 1 ? remaining[1] : (tie ? remaining[1] : remaining[2])
    final = switches ? (6 - alice - m) : alice
    return final == prize
end
